modelId.label: Model
modelId.help: Choose a model of the provider or type any model ID. Empty: the default model of the provider

dryRun.label: Dry run
dryRun.help: Log write requests instead of executing them

writeAllow.label: Write allowlist
writeAllow.help: One regular expression per line. The agent may only write states whose ID matches one of them.

confirmRequired.label: Confirmation required
confirmRequired.help: One regular expression per line. A write to a matching state (it must also be on the allowlist) happens only after the user confirms it with a button in Telegram.

historyInstance.label: History instance
historyInstance.help: Empty: the default history of the system settings

timeZone.label: Time zone
timeZone.help: IANA name such as Europe/Berlin. Empty: the time zone of the ioBroker server

telegramInstance.label: Telegram instance
telegramInstance.help: Empty: the agent does not use Telegram

telegramPrefix.label: Prefix
telegramPrefix.help: Only messages that start with this text go to the agent, e.g. /ai. Empty: every message of an allowed user

telegramUsers.label: Allowed Telegram users
telegramUsers.help: Telegram user ID, user name or first name (as in the telegram adapter), one per line. Messages from anyone else are ignored.
